facts.fact: The head of the PAPE Digitalisation project management unit told the project's steering committee on 25 March 2025 that the first phase had connected 268 health establishments to the Système d'Information Hospitalier (SIH) and the Dossier Patient Informatisé (DPI), as reported by the health ministry's DISD; the document gives no denominator and does not say which tiers the 268 are, and it names access to rural areas and scaling up as remaining challenges.

The SIH and DPI rollout is run by the PAPE Digitalisation project management unit under a steering committee that met on 25 March 2025 at the health ministry's cabinet, chaired by the deputy director of cabinet representing the health minister and attended by the ministry's central directorates (DAF, DGS, DISD, DIS) and a representative of the digital transition ministry, according to the DISD.

The steering committee of 25 March 2025 put the financing needed for health digitalisation at 97 billion FCFA by 2030, listed mobilising resources among the challenges and resolved to seek additional funding through other partners; the DISD account does not say who has financed the SIH and DPI so far.

Among the actions to come that the steering committee set on 25 March 2025 was to define a global, inclusive and detailed plan for the digitalisation of the health system, which the DISD account presents as not yet existing; it names no current strategy or costed plan covering the DPI.
